# Fall in Ballantyne: Wine Festivals, Farmers Markets, and a Whole Lot of Patio Nights


Two boutique communities, one incredible Ballantyne fall.


Tri Pointe Homes


•


August 20, 2026


Share this article


Ballantyne does not slow down for fall...it just gets better. The patios fill up a little earlier. The Bowl smells like whiskey and woodsmoke by October. And somewhere between the wine festival and the farmers market, you realize you haven't needed to leave a two-mile radius all season. If you've never spent an autumn in Ballantyne, here's your sign —[Ross Farms](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/ross-farms) and[Ascend](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/ascend) put you minutes from all of it, with two boutique communities to choose from.


Here's what's on the calendar this season, plus a little about the two addresses putting you close to it.


---


## First, a Little About Where You'd Be Living


Ross Farms · Ascend · Ballantyne, NC


> *Ross Farms and Ascend are two boutique townhome communities in the heart of Ballantyne, sharing a collection of thoughtfully designed floor plans — each dressed in its own architectural style, so the two communities feel like entirely different neighborhoods even as they share the same DNA.*


[Ascend](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/ascend) rises above with bold, beautiful architecture — a striking, modern take on Ballantyne living, including the Marquis plan's first-floor GenSmart Suite: a full bedroom, bath, and living space built for guests or multi-generational living, with end-unit options for extra light and privacy.


[Ross Farms](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/ross-farms) takes its name from the land it sits on, and it shows — the Aster and Bloom plans lean into warm, farmhouse-inspired exteriors, with flexible first-floor suites and balconies made for morning coffee.


Both communities are boutique by design, offer full personalization through the Design Studio, and are walkable to top-rated schools while staying close to everything vibrant Ballantyne life has to offer.


Every home is shaped by our Design Studio, twice named Best Design Center/Showroom at the MAME Awards. Move-in ready homes are already thoughtfully curated by our award-winning design team, finish by finish. Prefer to make it entirely your own? You'll work directly with that same expert team to personalize your home from the ground up — cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and finishes, all guided by professionals who know exactly how it should come together.


Either way, the result is the same: a home that feels intentional, not default. Both communities are also built with LivingSmart® technology for comfort, efficiency, and wellness. With Ballantyne's shopping, dining, and entertainment just minutes away, neither community is adjacent to the good stuff. They're built around it.


---


## 🍷 Ballantyne Wine & Food Festival | Saturday, September 26


> Ballantyne's Backyard


Ballantyne's Backyard at The Bowl transforms into a tasting ground for over 100 wines, beers, and spirits, running noon to 5pm. Pair it with bites from Bowl restaurants and you've got a full afternoon without ever needing to drive.


---


## 🥃 Whiskey, Wine & Fire Festival | Saturday, October 24


> Ballantyne's Backyard


The fall food-and-drink lineup closes out with this one — whiskey, wine, and fire pits at Ballantyne's Backyard, running 4 to 9pm. Cooler weather, good pours, and the kind of evening that makes autumn in Ballantyne worth the wait.


---


## 🥕 Ballantyne Farmers Market | First Wednesdays, September & October


> Brixham Park


After a summer break, the Farmers Market returns to Brixham Park for September and October, held the first Wednesday of each month from 10am to 1pm. Local vendors, fresh produce, and a genuinely cute little park make this an easy midweek stop.


---


## 🎶 Live Music at Ballantyne Village | Fall Patio Nights


> Ballantyne Village


Ballantyne Village brings back live music for the fall season, drawing patio diners out for an evening of food and entertainment. Grab dinner, catch a set, and let the night stretch a little longer than planned.


---


## 🎤 Concert Season at The Amp


> The Amp Ballantyne


The Amp Ballantyne's fall lineup is stacked: Houndmouth, Daniel Donato's Cosmic Country, and Molly Tuttle take the stage September 25, Clint Black & Midland bring their live show October 8, and Trampled by Turtles closes it out October 17. Grab dinner nearby, walk over, and let the season's best outdoor shows do the rest.


---


## 🍽️ The Bowl's Restaurant Scene Keeps Growing


> Ballantyne, NC


Fall means new tables to try. PopUp Bagels, Brasserie Copain, and South Block have all opened at The Bowl in the past year, along with Dunbar Social by Topgolf at The Ballantyne Hotel and Azul Tequileria & Cocina in the Village. Mister O1 is set to open at The Bowl this fall, and Reid's Fine Foods is coming soon near the Village — plenty of reasons to make a weekly reservation habit.


---


## ⛸️ Bonus: Ice Skating Returns to The Bowl


> The Bowl


Fall rolls right into the holidays here — The Bowl's outdoor ice skating rink returns November 22 through January 4. Consider it fall's last stretch turning into winter's first tradition, all without leaving the neighborhood.


---


## So... how close is "close," exactly?


From Ross Farms and Ascend, you're looking at roughly:


-


Ballantyne Village: about 1.8 miles — roughly a 5-minute drive


-


The Bowl at Ballantyne: about 2 miles — roughly a 5-minute drive


-


Brixham Park (Farmers Market): about 2.2 miles — roughly a 6-minute drive


Close enough that "let's just go" is basically the default plan every weekend this fall.


---
